title: The Machine Without Qt: A Station That Ran Where It Was Built, What Was Not Shipped, and the Path That Only Exists Here

questions.question: A station runs on the machine it was built on and not on a robot. What is the likely cause?
options: Something it needed was found on the build machine and was not shipped
questions.explanation: The check reports what is missing from the folder.

questions.question: What does the pattern platforms/*offscreen* mean?
options: A file in the platforms folder whose name has offscreen in it, on any system

questions.question: A folder is missing two things. In what order are they reported?
options: The order the patterns were asked for

questions.question: A qt.conf says Prefix=/home/builder/Qt/6.2/gcc_64. Why is that a problem on a robot?
options: That path exists only on the builder
questions.explanation: Qt looks in a place that is not there. It was reported as a stray path.

questions.question: Why does the check have to be run on a machine like the target?
options: On the build machine every path exists
questions.explanation: No path looks stray. The lesson says so under what it does not do.

questions.question: A plugin is found in the folder. Does that mean it loads?
options: Yes, if it is the right size
No: a plugin built for another version of Qt is refused when Qt starts
questions.explanation: The check looks at names and not versions.
